about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Style.about: VST3 parameter 1. Host display: 0 = Transparent; 1 = Punchy; 2 = Dynamic; 2 = Dynamic; 3 = Allround.

parameters/Attack.about: VST3 parameter 3. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 39.06 ms; 0.5 = 625.0 ms; 0.75 = 3.164 sec; 1 = 10.00 sec.

parameters/Release.about: VST3 parameter 4. Host display: 0 = 0.000 ms; 0.25 = 107.2 ms; 0.5 = 857.3 ms; 0.75 = 2.894 sec; 1 = 10.00 sec.

parameters/Dithering.about: VST3 parameter 8. Host display: 0 = Off; 1 = 16 Bits; 3 = 20 Bits; 4 = 22 Bits; 5 = 24 Bits.

parameters/Noise Shaping.about: VST3 parameter 9. Host display: 0 = None; 1 = Basic; 2 = Optimized; 2 = Optimized; 3 = Weighted.

parameters/Bypass.about: VST3 parameter 10. Host display: 0 = Not Bypassed; 0 = Not Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed.

parameters/Lock Output.about: VST3 parameter 12. Host display: 0 = Unlocked; 0 = Unlocked; 1 = Locked; 1 = Locked; 1 = Locked.

parameters/Receive Midi.about: VST3 parameter 13. Host display: 0 = Enabled; 0 = Enabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled.

parameters/Interface: Meter Scale.about: VST3 parameter 14. Host display: 0 = -16 dB; 1 = -32 dB; 3 = K-12; 4 = K-14; 5 = K-20.

parameters/Interface: Show Advanced.about: VST3 parameter 15. Host display: 0 = Hide; 0 = Hide; 1 = Show; 1 = Show; 1 = Show.

parameters/Interface: Show Display.about: VST3 parameter 16. Host display: 0 = Hide Display; 0 = Hide Display; 1 = Show Display; 1 = Show Display; 1 = Show Display.

parameters/Interface: Show Meters.about: VST3 parameter 17. Host display: 0 = Hide Meters; 0 = Hide Meters; 1 = Show Meters; 1 = Show Meters; 1 = Show Meters.

parameters/Interface: Show Inter-Sample.about: VST3 parameter 18. Host display: 0 = Ignore ISP; 0 = Ignore ISP; 1 = Show ISP; 1 = Show ISP; 1 = Show ISP.
